features.body: Store and share information provided by governments — name, surname, date of birth, nationality.
Store and share information provided by trusted private sources.

discover.copy: Privacy-preserving age checks built on the OpenID Connect standard, part of Scytáles’ EU Commission mandate.
Certified ISO 18013-5 validation for wallets, mobile IDs, and mobile driving licences, online and offline.
NFC card authentication that derives credentials from security documents into mobile virtual IDs.

statement: Scytáles is the global leader in the 18013 parts 5 and 7 standardization work for mobile IDs and mobile driving licences, having passed all international interoperability tests and is ready with a fully standardized, tested and certified mobile ID solution. Scytáles runs the world's first ISO-compliant mobile ID pilot in Utah, USA, with its partner GET Group NA.
